interpretation_limits: Article 3(2)(a) requires the National Environmental Agency to submit the annual State Water Resources Monitoring Plan to the Minister for approval no later than 1 December.
Article 3(2)(c) separately requires access to monitoring data subject to applicable law; the cited text does not set a public-release deadline of 1 December.
No official submission evidence was verified in this run. This is not evidence that the plan was not submitted.
No legal compliance or breach determination is made.
